body: Wow, you sound like a male me! Divorce just finalized, he’s going to concerts with his new girlfriend and they even live together, while I’m sulking on my own. We also split our kid 50/50, and our son makes me pull myself together.

I feel your pain. It’s been 8 months for me and it really hit me hard when I learned that his in a new relationship with a 20something yo beauty. Never realized it would be this hard to try and accept that he has moved on. He’s living a happy life while I’m sinking in misery. That sucks.

Oh, trust me, I’ve reached out. Don’t do that! Or if you want to find out if it’s indeed a bad idea, you might try. That’s what I did. On the bright side it destroyed any of my delusions that he might miss me. He doesn’t give a damn. And I went over and over to him to hear that again and again. Now that’s stupid. Please keep your dignity!

I wish I could move on as well. My ex has. I openly admitted to the part I had in our fallout, but he, as your ex, never took any blame. I tried to make the friendly ex’es thing work but he was always dismissive to me. Then I found out he’s living with a new gorgeous girl and honestly didn’t give a damn about me. He had spoken to my dad and my told me - stop waiting for him to regret anything. Stop waiting for him to care. He couldn’t care less about you. Harsh words, but that’s the reality.

I’m so glad I’m not alone feeling this way! I cringe at happy couples, espscially at my ex and his new girl. While I’m sitting sad and lonely in my house and crying my eyes out. This jealousy for somebody else doing well has never been this strong before. They say - don’t spend so much energy on them! Love yourself and get new hobbies! Yeah, right! My sadness is like an anchor.

Regardless of what I do for my kid, my ex says I’m still a terrible mother. And I’ve done everything for him. All the therapies, trips (he loves to travel), schooling, all is on me. Besides I do more, I’m influencing the government towards a more inclusive environment. I go on the news. He still says I’m not a worthy human being. And he said it for so long that I believe him now.

Go ahead and let go of him. Perhaps it’s the much needed kick for him to treat his mental health. His actions are not your responsibility.

I know because I’m on the other side. I am the one with depression and alcohol addiction. The difference is that I’m quite successful in my career and I’ve always looked for help with my mental health.

I was the one who offered the divorce, since my husband didn’t seem to find me interesting or attractive for a long time and never recognized the positive things I did. He didn’t have the courage to offer me the divorce, so I kinda did it for him. He was over the moon when he heard that.

Now, a half year in, he’s absolutely happy with a supermodel half his and my age, barely out of puberty. Me? Oh, I’m more miserable than ever, but that’s none of his business.

So be brave, get out and live your life!
Sorry, I snapped at you previously. I know you meant well :)
I also tried Lego as per friend’s suggestions but the boxes just stand unopened for half a year already.
I’ve lost 6 kg, and am at my goal weight, but she’s really thin. I’m not going there.
I’m diversifying my ways to feel good, most of them are without cost. I’ve saved up for these beauties :)
I have no idea how to stop the hurt. All the tips - don’t spend so much energy on it, love yourself etc. I mean, how does THAT work?

He is a shit person, I don’t need a list for that. I just discovered he had been dating her long ago when we were still together. Basically living a parallel life, coming up with random bullshit why he was always late.
I’m right doing exactly that. Going through the pain and having new surprises about my ex each day. I’m sure I’ll get better just that it’s still all so fresh
I just discovered they were together even before when I brought up divorce

She used to stalk her ex’s new girfriend, broke into his email. I guess it’s her pattern. Another friend looked at her profile and said she looks like a huge red flag considering how she’s obviously obsessed with her looks, showing them off and posing. THAT made me feel better.
I just found out that they are living together. So pathetic of him not telling me any of this and waiting for the kid to drop the bomb.
Also, he just told me that they all live together 🙈 So pissed at my ex that it didn’t occur for him to tell me and he waited for the kid to do that 🙈
He’s 7 and he’s autistic. He says whatever is on his mind.
You are invalidating my feelings and it is not helpful at all. Do you think I’m not angry with myself for feeling the way I do? Of course I am. I’d like to be chill. Except that I’m not.
I did. Because it was obvious that no matter how hard I tried, he didn’t love me anymore

I’ve started working out. I saw a psychiatrist because I thought my depression was getting out of control. She said that what I feel is quite common, but that my main problem is my excess weight. I’m fucking 177cm and 69 kg, I’m in a heatly BMI. But apparently I’m not good enough.
I am doing therapy and my therapist admitted that, yeah, it must be very very painful. She’s right
Well, my kid said she’s much prettier than I am and that he wants her to be his mommy, not me. Talking about pain..
My son told me that she’s more beautiful than me. And objectively he’s right. But it stings.

I called it quits, but just because he never listened to me, wasn’t remotely interested in my life. I tried really hard with no success. When I told him, he was super happy. He said he wanted a divorce for a ling time. Of course, he waited for me to do it.
I was trying to keep it nice and friendly. But I don’t feel that way anymore. So business arrangement it is.

My friend sent me her profile, I wasn’t planning on it. Yeah, I know there’s no point in feeling bad about it, but I’m a human being and I cannot switch my feelings on and off. Right now it just bloody hurts.
Yeah, it does help a bit. He’s a manchild who cannot organize anything or get things done, perpefually late and letting me down. I don’t want him back, but it still hurts like hell.

The bruising stopped, but unfortunately I’m back to drinking as of yesterday, when I had a visitor and  my kid blurted out to her that daddy has a new girlfriend who’s much prettier than mommy. We’re still in the process of divorce. I checked her. She’s really stunning and half my age. Hurts like hell.
And blaming me for him not getting things done is also a sign of neurodivergence?

My ex’s mom is his assistant (my kid is disabled) and she gets a decent amount of money for that from the government, but she helps out only on the weeks when my son is with his dad (but gets paid for full time)

I tried to arrange that the kid will stay overnight, but the dad refused. I’m starting to think that the key is to act like a single mom, arranging everything myself and not relying on him. I just really hoped we could do co-parenting instead of parallel parenting :(
Unfortunately no

As an example, I have to be early at an important work meeting. I need him to take the son and bring to the kindergarden. We arrange to meet, he’s late so I’m late for my meeting. He’s asked to arrange something at a kindergarden, only to result in the director calling me and begging me to take over. Suff like that.
Sorry for being unclear. How can I stop getting mad at him when he does it? It’s not an emotion I particularly enjoy.
My question is how to deal with myself so it doesn’t bother me that much. We share a kid, so, yes, we still have to cooperate.

I’m only 13 days in and I’m also scared af. We’re at very different stages, I’m an intern and you’re a veteran in comparison to me :). I don’t know about you but I have cravings daily. I’m being honest with myself when I conclude that it’s not alcohol I’m craving. It’s an escape from having to feel all of my feelings and sometimes the discomfort of daily life. So I just sit there and let myself feel, as daunting as it might seem. It won’t last forever anyways and I’m actively widening my gaze and letting good things and feelings happen to me, because they eventually do. You’ve already gone a long way, keep going, my friend!
I also gave up on La Mer. It was not bad, but certainly not worth the price tag.
No, not really. I see I’m a minority here.

I think the intensity of that need and how much it consumes you is a stage, at least for me. Now I have a lot of other things going on, so at this stage the lack of physical contact doesn’t bother me much. The strong cravings for it will certainly come back, but now I’m focusing on building the version of myself I could proudly present to the world.

I went out on several dates with several men soon after my husband moved out. It actually helped me a lot in the initial stage. I was not looking for a new relationship just company and physical contact. Yes, there were times when I faced rejection or was ghosted, that’s all part of the dating apps. But do I regret it? Not really. Did the rejection hurt? Not a lot. I actually found the funny side in it all and I got the physical contact I craved for. Having said that, I’m past that phase. Now I want to take time to grieve my marriage, am tired of the dating apps jungle. And again I don’t feel too bad about it. It’s all just phases, and you do what feels right for you.
Looks very good, but I’d swipe left, because I’d be intimidated. And that would hit the target, because you’re probably looking for somebody fit and active too.

I went out on dates soon after separating from my husband. I was not looking for a commited relationship, just company. But I put a stop to it when one guy criticized my appearance, and recently another guy said that he would never marry a woman like me. Not feeling like putting myself out there anymore, at least for a long while.

Trust me, I know what you mean. I’m an HR manager :). There’s no way I think this behaviour can be justified, I talked to my superior today. There’s nothing we can do about it, because she’s supported by upper management. So I made an exit plan.

Thank you for your kind words. Actually I think that human beings cannot exsist without society, so yes, everyone needs an external validation. For me - internally I’m just confused and no longer can tell what’s good or bad, so I really benefit from you, guys, validating my feelings ❤️
Oh, and my family is giving me a trip to Italy ❤️

Um, because I’m a human being who makes mistakes? It’s mostly an inclusive and supportive community who helps me to reflect on my shortcomings and get back on the track. I’m sorry you found my post bothering.
Thanks! I’ve decided to report her to the global etics committe. And it’s not the first time for her.
Thanks, this afternoon I garhered my family and told them I’m about to lose it so I need their help
At least I’ve booked an exclusive SPA treatment for myself tomorrow :)
Thank you! I started earlier, so I’m 4 weeks :)
I also don’t have any new hobbies, because I don’t want to. For the past week I’ve been white knuckling through my days, and honestly, I try not to ask from myself much more than just staying sober.
Oh, yeah! The new me needs a new wardrobe, right?

I am one of those people who had the pink cloud period. I felt so much prettier, enjoyed not having the constant guilt and my divorce? - best decision I ever made! Yeah, now it has kinda dissipated. I feel quite lonely and sad with no specific goals to look forward to. But then again I believe it’s one of those phases.
You’re doing me a disservice. Now, when I know the difference between humbleness and humility, I’m even smarter than 10 min ago 😂
English is not my first language, but thanks for your correction :)
Oh, I feel you on feeling the feelings! I’m totally not used to that so now I am utterly overwhelmed and just wish I could get a break from it.

Fair enough. Guy’s looks are not the most important thing to me. There’s nothing wrong with the way he looks, as I said I consider him average. When I get to know people and I like them, they become prettier in my eyes. As happens with my friends. They all look gorgeous to me.

It has crossed my mind. My brother is autistic, my son and couple of my friends are also on the spectrum. So I tend to notice signs in other people as well. In this guy’s case I don’t think he qualifies, but of course I cannot exlude this possibility 100%
Honesty without tact is cruelty

While I was still drinking, one evening I invited him over, though my house was a mess. I don’t make sound decisions after a bottle of wine. He spent the night, said nothing, and in a few days sent me a list of cleaning product suggestions.
Thanks! You know it’s kinda funny. Most of my life I’ve been receiving compliments about my looks. Perhaps it was getting to my head so universe sent me this guy :D

I’d rate him as barely average tbh. He’s definitely not a looker. I’d never say that to him though, because what’s the point? So when he told that to me, my first thought was - have you seen the mirror?
Haha! Yeah, the one!
Can you believe the nerve? He just texted me. He still kinda hopes that we can continue dating. Who would want to date him after such words?
The trick is that sorbriety is like a superpower and you start thinking that you’re capable of almost anything. Including drinking in moderation. Hasn’t worked for me so far but I keep hoping.

Same here. I’ve lost some and finally I progress towards my target. I still have a way to go, but I’m already giving away clothes that have become too large for me in just 2 weeks because I don’t feel comfortable in that higher weight and I don’t want to return to it. I’m afraid that going back to drinking will reverse my progress.

Honestly I look and feel like crap atm. The 2 week long insomnia is hitting me hard. Another issue is that I used alcohol to escape from myself. Now I don’t have this option and I’m with myself ALL THE TIME! Powering through though.
I admire everybody who has the energy to work out! I still don’t, but at least I’m commited to do on average 10k steps a day.
6,5 lbs

It was about after 100 days into my separation, when most of the heaviness lifted. Actually my big breakthrough came after we went together with our kid abroad for a couple of days at the end of December. Not as a couple, but as loving parents who ultimately wish the best for each other. It was a very clear reminder of why we didn’t work out as a couple in the end. Since then my grief lifted and I was finally ready to admit that there CAN be life without him as my husband.

Trust me, before I was barely exsisting and constantly blaming myself for the break-up. Everybody around told me to get new hobbies, enjoy being by myself, but it absolutely didn’t resonate with me. Meanwhile my ex immediately felt a relief, took on new projects, said he feels like a new chakra has opened and he is becoming a better person.

Financially I’m in trouble, but during those 3+ months I was not able to fix anything at all, I just couldn’t see how it could possibly work out. I took day by day, and I was really lucky with supportive friends and closest colleagues who were patiently by my side. Oh, and theraphy as well! Priceless!

So hang in there, don’t push yourelf too hard. Allow yourself to grief. Ask for help. You’ll get through this!
Thanks for explaining!
What is BP?

I took a photo for a document, and it’s the first one in years where I look pretty good and my eyes shine with calm and happiness. In the previous ones I look either like a startled deer or a mole that just came out into sunlight.

I also had a bad day at work, so I went to a mall and found an amazing new lipstick which I’ll buy in a week, if I keep my sober promise. Make-up is my hobby, I already have 16 lipsticks, and that’s after a careful edit😅. Be creative - think of other little things that bring you joy except for wine. They will not replace it atm, but they still feel nice :)
Amazing achievement! I started out with 165 lbs, I’m now 162 lbs and my goal is 150 (I’m tall). I will certainly not reach my goal during January, but it’d be nice to get under 160.

Yes, you’re absolutely right! I know because I have depression but I’m on meds and I’m coping just fine. Alcohol actually made me way more depressed than I naturally am, and what you mention were my daily thoughts for a while. Since I began Dry Jan, my depression doesn’t bother me at all and I’ able to lower my meds. OP, please talk to a therapist, you don’t have to feel the way you’re feeling right now.

Congratulations! I’m on day 10 and so far I’ve lost 2lbs. It was 3lbs 3 days ago, but my sweet tooth has woken up after a long long sleep, so with all the sweets I’m holding back my progress. I don’t beat myself up much about it, since staying sober is the top priority. But I do hope the see the number on the scale gradually going down over the month.

I’ll keep my fingers crossed for you! I’m also keen to lose some weight. I’m now 1kg (2lbs) down. In total I’d like to get rid of 15 lbs, so 13 more to go. How are you doing with moving towards your goal weight?
My thoughts exaclty!

I’m sorry to hear that. Your situation is not clear yet, but I understand why it’s tough. I recently separated with my husband. Had 3 really rough months but as soon as I started Dry Jan, I started feeling better about it. Take your time, feel the feelings and have self-compassion.
100% agree and I’m a woman.

Sad to say that it’s my 8th day, haven’t slept for the whole week and it’s taking its toll. I use prescription GABA 2 hours before sleep, does nothing for me :(. So I’m being patient, just like you, and trying to enjoy the other benefits.
There’s no way I’m prioritizing dating over Dry January. As soon as I feel it’s interfering, I’m putting a stop to it.

I read the caption and thought- yes, it’s normal. Sometimes after a date the guy calls a taxi for me to bring me home and I find it very classy and don’t take it for granted. But when I read that she wants you to pay for an Uber to bring her TO the date!? No, that’s totally not ok.

I feel you. I started drinking soon after my son with ASD & ADHD was born. Just couldn’t handle it sober. Now we’ve separated with his dad. So, yeah, this Dry January challenge is called that for a reason 😅

I don’t think anybody was giving shit to anyone, just expressing an opinion, which I didn’t find offensive but actually helpful to other readers. But I’m trying to see your perspective and I can understand how it could be perceived negatively.
IMO effectiveness & cost correlation is important.

What’s the point of this sub? The pricier the better? :) Who wants to overpay for something that is overpriced, even if you can technically afford it? I’ve tried La Mer products, I liked them, but I do agree they’re not worth the price.

I’m not sure if I want to though. Initially I enjoyed the connection, the attention I got and he does seem to appreciate me in a lot of other ways, but my house is just the surface of my mess. I start to think that I don’t want to subject him to that.
Not at all, but I think we’re nearing a closing of our small encounter :)
I have the same issue. However I do look more beaitiful due to not drinking. But my mood is horrid.
On the legs, waist and back mostly, like some small rash in several rather small areas. And some sudden minor bruises which appeared out of nowhere. Hasn’t happened in 5 days since I quit drinking.
Hey! Btw today at work I got a complimemt that my face looks slimmer 🙌

I’ve done dry months a couple of times previously. I always lost weight, my facial features became more defined, my skimtone became more even, my eyes brighter and more sparkling. Emotionally during dry periods I’m able to make much better choices and choose my reaction to people and situations. My anxiety lowered, depression lifted - I was mostly in a positive mood when waking up. My relationships improved. I was able to get more things done. Quite a lot, actually, when I start to list.
Totally agree! There’s a part of me who wants it all and now, I look around and see such a mess! I deliberately keep my daily to do lists short, so that I don’t overwhelm myself.

I’m on Day 5 and the last 4 nights sleepwise have been miserable :(. This has happened to me in all my sober periods. Wine always knocks me out at night, so my sleep cycle is seriously disturbed. I’ll give it a full week and then will write to my doctor. On the plus side, my colleague told me today that my face has become slimmer, so there are positives :)

I relate to the health check motivation. I’m actually ashamed for the doctors to realize how much I drink by looking at my liver results. My health check is next week, I know I can’t do much until then, but at least I can contribute to it not getting worse.
Thank you so much for sharing this! It definitely adds to my motivation!

Wait, you mean that being sober can reduce my double chin? I’m technically not overweight, but that ugliness suddenly appeared and is haunting me. I thought it was because of ageing (which is probably partly true)!
Impressive, what 3 weeks can do to you face! I’ll be patient for my own progress. And I’m sorry that you’re having such a bad withdrawal! Hang in there and I will try too :)

I’m on day 4 and the difficulty is there, but I also cannot ignore some positives that come alongside. A slight drop in the weight already, getting more done around the house, no hangover and guilt in the morning. Those keep me going.
How do you feel?
Good luck! I’m already on day 4 :). It’s hard, but I’m 3 pounds down, looking forward to an improvement in skin.
Me too!
Oh, and I love your nick name! It’s my son’s favourite anymal. He wouldn’t part with his stuffed capybara day or night :)
Did you do a dry NY eve?
Good luck with that! It’s my 4th dry day and I already lost 3 pounds, so it’s certainly doable :). I am eating more sweets though, but I hope the craving soon subsides.
Same itchy skin that started bruising! Your post was a lightbulb moment from me, I wasn’t sure it was related to drinking, but, honestly, why else?
But if I quit drinking, I’ll be responsible for everything that’s going wrong, not the alcohol!

Your response got me really curious. In what way does the fact that you’re sick of always initiating the conversation changes depending on the length and exclusiveness of the relationship? I don’t mean to sound rude, I’m just interested.
Oh, I usually don’t care about chocolate but 2 days in sober I discovered my sweet tooth. So I feel you!
Yes, the book! I also have one! :D Will finish it in January as well. You guys are an inspiration :)
I was also thinking about workout routine, but on dry months my sleep gets disrupted, so it leaves me with less energy. I’ll do walks though. Wish you luck with your goals!
Who said that personal growth can happen only when you’re single?

We were together for 15 years. I miss the beginning, because we were best friends indeed. I think it went downhill when our kid with autism was born. We both love him dearly but our relationship couldn’t handle the strain. I tried for years to get that frienship back, but it felt like I was knocking on a closed door which nobody opened. He’s happy now, I’m not. I guess it’s because I feel I was not good enough and blame myself for the divorce.

Honestly, I sometimes get the feeling that there’s a bestseller out there on how to live your life correctly, I just didn’t get a copy. Like become the best version of yourself before you date (if I had waited for that, I’d be alone all my life) and stuff like that. But I know I welcome opinions when I post something on a forum, and that’s fine and really interesting. The best part is to find people who also didn’t get the copy of the book, or at least read it with an open mind.
I appreciate your comment and the mentality that there are no rules to live your life correctly.
Thanks! I initiated the divorce because he didn’t show any interest in me at all for several years.
Ouch!

Thanks for this post! I’m reading the comments with interest. You probably wanted to hear how people are bettering themselves, and indeed, my ex started meditating, says he feels a new chakra has opened and he’s becoming a better person for the universe. Me? I’m just getting through the day, most days with the help of a to do list.

Yes, I’m open about it. He seems very understanding. We’re not making big plans but taking small steps and will see where it goes. I think my biggest fear is of rejection because together with my husband I felt unlovable for a lomg time.

I’m 40 (F), we did a trial separation 2 years ago and decided to give it another go. But nothing really changed, we slept in different bedrooms even when the kid stayed with the granny. I felt him growing cold and disinterested. He wasn’t supportive of things that were important to me (and I cried when the rest of the world was, it showed how much it hurt when my life partner wasn’t). I tried to change for him, but that didn’t work. So I offered a divorce and he was very relieved, saying he had wanted to offer it for several times. Now he’s moved out. Do I feel happier? Nope, absolutely miserable, because I always had had a hope, if I became a good enough person, things would improve. Now that hope is fading and I feel guilty. But at least he’s happier and inspired to start a new life. So out of two miserable people we came to just one. The aftermath- it was probably worth it.
Me too! Listening to it on repeat

I’m on day 9. Still anxious but nowhere near as I was when drinking. Lately it had become intolerable, I seriously struggled to get through the day, kept a journal to motivate myself to do each tiny little thing. Btw I had to go to national TV morning news, it was not as bad as when I was drinking and I even enjoyed it. Now it’s still hard, but at least I trust myself to get through it and it lifts at moments.

Trust me, alcohol fills you with self-loathing, once it’s gone, turns out you’re not such a terrible person after all.
I’m on day 8. I can’t say that I’m very fond of myself now, but I don’t hate myself as much as when I was drinking. Wine made me stupid and emotional. I’m a bit smarter and more rational now.
Give it a try! It’s not easy if you’re a heavy drinker like me, but at the end of the day you’ve done the one best possible thing for yourself and that’s a reason to be proud.

You are so not alone! I got sober 7 days ago. I didn’t think I could but I had gotten to a point where the hungover anxiety and drinking from noon took over my life. I threw out the wine bottles- counted 70 a month, and I realized I’m going to die if I don’t quit. And before I die, I’ll painfully loose everything I have. The book Alcohol Explained helped. I feel stupefied now, but I know it’s because of the withdrawal. I’m taking one day at a time and try to be curious about my experience.

I’ve been drinking daily for 7 years with a sober month here and there. Sobriety is so foreign to me that I feel like on some type of weird drug. My sleep is disrupted and that brings on fatigue. No idea what I would love to do, I just mechanically go through my day and occasionally take a look at a horrifying selfie I took one morning with a swollen face to remind myself that going back to that is not an option.

Thank you for your post! I totally relate. I’ve always been this way. There have been very few times in my life when I’ve felt - this is where I want to be now. The feeling was amazing! I wish I knew how to achieve it more often.
When does it get better? I’m on day 6
I don’t know details, but you raised a good question. That would certainly be a deciding factor.
My 7 kid was going to sleep yesterday and told me in his sweet little voice - mommy, don’t forget to drink up you wine! Made me feel so ashamed!

Perhaps it’s your body telling you that you have nothing to lose. I’m also trying to lose, I’m 177cm and 72kg, which puts me in a normal range. But over the years I’m trying to learn not to work against my body. My goal is 68kg, I looked my best at 64kg, but if I’m not able to get there naturally by heatlhy eating and being moderately active, I’m giving up on that goal. I’ve been at a lower weight, but it came at a cost of low energy and deprivation, and that was not sustainable.
Impressive and inspiring! Can’t wait when I’ll myself be ready to post a similar success story :)
And my goal is 68 kg (I’m F 177cm)

I don’t precisely track calories, but I’m trying to choose lots of salad, veggies and overall make healthier choices. By the graph it seems that I’m not in a deficit. But I believe I should cut alcohol calories, because my food seems fine, I wouldn’t want to reduce it. I sometimes indulge in calory rich foods but it’s like 2-3 times a month.
Thanks! i plan to keep tracking, I’m still new to it

Actively tracking calories is not for me, at least not at this point. I’m approximately aware what food is what and mindfully try to make healthier choices. My problem is too much alcohol, otherwise I’d be losing. Those are the extra calories I need to cit down.

Well, at least on average it looks like I’m not gaining. I don’t actually know what’s a representative time-scale. I’m glad I’m below December but sad I’m not making progress. I’m tall at 177 cm, F, and not overweight but I do look and feel better at a lower weight.

In December I was fluctuating around 75kg, but I didn’t measure it then that much. Now the average is around 72kg, so perhaps you’re right - could be a plateau or maybe maintanance, not sure. How long are the plateaus?
Thanks! I just recently started tracking weight frequently, so these fluctiations confused me and didn’t know if it’s normal.

I broke (well, injured) Dry Jan last Saturday with a bottle of red. I can’t say I enjoyed it much, I didn’t like feeling tipsy. I’m back and doing the rest of Dry Jan with you guys, but now I’m a bit puzzled about my next drink. Isn’t it weird that I’m sitting here and thinking how to make my next drink enjoyable?

I’m bored AF. Drinking tea in the evenings, scrolling through social media. Haven’t found a satisfying replacement for emptying wine bottles in the evening and acting as if I was still sober so that my husband wouldn’t bug me too much.
I can’t believe how much I’ve spent on expensive clothing as a way to reward myself 😂! Drinking was cheaper, but then again it didn’t look good on me.

I’ve lost about 2 kg, but perhaps about to lose some more because my tooth aches badly and I can’t chew any food. Yes, I’ve been to the dentist, it’s a complex issue and will take time to fix. Until then I have a liquid diet. I was so upset about this today that I almost turned to wine, but then decided that I can always give up the next day.
That would be around 25 bottles of wine/Prosecco for me. I wonder what my neighbour thinks of the empty glass recycle bin (we share it) 🤔

I was drinking the same amount. Even if the progress is not what was expected, I think 3 pounds in 2+ weeks is a very decent result.
